title: Yeasty Canadian Peas Stew
description: A comforting and filling Canadian dish featuring split peas, double-fried chicken, and a hint of yeast, perfect for a cold winter night. This recipe is Jain-friendly and serves as a great crowd-pleaser.

ingredients.name: Double-Fried Chicken
ingredients.notes: Cut into 1-inch pieces before adding to stew.

instructions: Combine split peas, carrots, onions, garlic, and yeast in a large pot.
Add vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add double-fried chicken to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes or until the chicken is heated through.
Transfer the stew to a baking dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot with melted butter, bread, and a side salad.
Cook chicken in batches in a skillet with oil until cooked through. Double-fry by deep-frying until crispy, then baking in the oven for an additional 10 minutes.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces.
